title: A Busy Day
scene: 从出门过马路到放学，串起路上、教室、上课、科目

sentences.text: Today was a busy day for me.
sentences.gloss: 今天对我来说是忙碌的一天。

sentences.text: First I got up early and washed my face, then I ate with my family.
sentences.gloss: 我先早早起床洗了脸，然后和家人一起吃饭。

sentences.text: Ben and I walked to school, and we waited for the green light before we crossed the road.
sentences.gloss: 本和我走路去学校，过马路之前我们等了绿灯。

sentences.text: We arrived at the gate, and we went up the stairs to our classroom.
sentences.gloss: 我们到了大门，走楼梯上去我们的教室。

sentences.text: We had math and English, and I raised my hand to answer a question.
sentences.gloss: 我们上了数学和英语，我举手回答了一个问题。

sentences.text: In the art lesson we talked and laughed, because our pictures were funny.
sentences.gloss: 美术课上我们又说又笑，因为我们的画很好笑。

sentences.text: After school the bus was full, so I stood near the window.
sentences.gloss: 放学后公交车很满，所以我站在窗边。

sentences.text: Finally I got off near my home, and I was very tired.
sentences.gloss: 最后我在家附近下了车，我非常累。

sentences.text: At the end of the day I went to bed and thought about tomorrow.
sentences.gloss: 一天结束的时候，我上床睡觉，想着明天。
